text:
nina: Quick question: i'm standardizing the sampleapp onboarding docs and want to pick one canonical env var for ephemeral tokens. current options: REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN, RW_API_TOKEN. thoughts?

omar: prefer RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN. explicit and unlikely to collide with other tools.

lee: agree. but SDKs should honor REDWOOD_API_KEY as legacy fallback with a warning to reduce friction.

nina: plan: SDK helper will check socket -> file -> env(RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN) -> legacy REDWOOD_API_KEY. will log WARN if legacy used.

pat: how do processes get updated tokens? env won't refresh already-running procs.

omar: recommend sidecar with socket and a small helper lib. libs should call getToken() which fetches from socket or file and can watch for changes.

lee: also include a dev-agent for local dev that emits 24h ephemerals and prints export lines for shells. docs should show docker-compose and macOS /tmp workaround.

infra-bot: deploy:local-dev-agent demo passed (build 3901). :white_check_mark:

nina: added request_id to renew-failure logs and metrics renewal_failures{project}. will add ERR codes (ERR_RENEW_401) for support.

pat: nice. let's keep the README snippet minimal and add a crosswalk table for JS/py naming parity.

nina: will do. thanks all.
